_comment: Multi-server attack chain seen in 2025-2026 research. A benign-looking 'quick-math' server shadows the mailer's send_email tool (TP03), hides a directive in invisible Unicode tag characters (TP02, ASCII smuggling) and in a nested schema enum (TP01, full-schema poisoning); the mailer is the known-malicious postmark-mcp (SUP02); and GitHub (reads attacker-authored issues) + filesystem + mail form a lethal trifecta for indirect prompt injection (FLOW01).
